items.title: SD-082 learning-signal probe: gradient persistence, return variance, advantage sign on rule-driven flips
items.note: Routed by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822f_2026-09-09 (routing: queue-experiment, NEW EXQ number, experiment_purpose diagnostic, claim_ids [SD-082]). Adjudicates the two hypotheses that autopsy pre-registered on the `learning-signal` axis: H-learning-signal-noisy and H-learning-signal-sign. 822f rejected registry leg H1 at adequate power but could not separate 'the trained coupling carries no signal' from 'the instrument cannot see it'; this probe measures the signal directly. AUTOPSY REFUSALS HONOURED: no 822g / same-design power bump, and NO criterion is the ON>OFF cross-candidate spread comparison (inconclusive by construction at n=5). Both arms are retained only for telemetry coverage of the same 10 cells; no criterion contrasts them. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readouts are per-P1-update gradient norm, step-direction persistence, per-episode return variance and per-sample advantage sign on flips. Checked 822f's manifest (v3_exq_822f_..._20260908T231145Z_v3) and the 822b/822c/822d lineage: NONE records any of them -- the autopsy's own Learning 7 states 'gradient content and direction persistence are unrecorded' and lists them as gaps for the next run. Not recoverable post-hoc -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): independent recount returns 3 counting runs for SD-082 (822b/822c/822d), meeting the threshold of 2, but the brake is RELEASED on the producer's own explicit record -- the 822f autopsy JSON carries re_derive_brake.fired=false with literal_count_meets_threshold=true, naming those same three runs, and licenses 'a NEW EXQ on the learning-signal axis' while refusing any same-design letter. Also within the skill's own 'not braked' exemption: new EXQ number, diagnostic, discriminating WHY. STEP 2.5c: resolved by call trace over 30 real ticks, not module-name matching. No open corrupting entry's defect is on this driver's path: salience_coordinator / regime_occupancy_gate / tonic_vigor / blocked_agency / selection_entropy_floor NOT executed; e1_deep::ContextMemory.write NOT executed (never trains E1). SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training overlaps on e1_deep::forward + ::predict_long_horizon and is dispositioned in the driver docstring rather than waved past: that path is universal (725 corpus scripts reach it, incl. V3-EXQ-1019), the entry is ready:true with its item-3 build chip already resolved done and status 'substrate_landed_validation_owed', and its defect (rollout score collapse) does not enter this DV chain (summaries are proposer_post_action, and the readiness gate is independent of E1 by construction). GOVERNANCE FINDING REPORTED, not acted on: that entry's substrate_paths will spuriously gate every future agent-stepping experiment through Step 2.5c -- the same shape governance already corrected for SD-082 on 2026-09-09. red-team (claude-opus-5; `fable` override refused with HTTP 429 monthly spend limit, re-spawned once inheriting the session model per the skill): BLOCKING -> FIXED. F1 found C2's fixed 0.25 persistence ceiling was derived for SGD while the statistic is measured over ADAM parameter deltas; independently re-measured in-session on the real head geometry (SGD pure-noise 0.120, reproducing the original derivation; ADAM pure-noise 0.4488-0.463, scale-invariant, crossing 0.25 only at T~300 vs this run's 70), confirming C2 could NOT fire even with its hypothesis maximally true and that two of five verdict labels were unreachable. Fixed at cause, NOT by lowering a bar: C2 is now bracketed by two IN-RUN controls (a pure-noise Adam negative control giving the floor, the dense-synthetic-credit positive control giving the ceiling) and fires below their midpoint; measured valid in 10/10 cells (floor 0.4488, ceilings 0.716-0.764, midpoints 0.582-0.606), and an anchor-reachability guard now scores the SHIPPED C2 predicate against a noise-floor reference (it would have failed outright against the old 0.25 bar). F3 (EMA baseline warm-up can manufacture the C3 contrast arithmetically) FIXED: C3 now requires sign agreement with a de-trended contrast and records Spearman(episode, flip rate). F4 FIXED: MIN_FLIP_SAMPLES=20 on the fresh-select-only count, replacing a >0 check. F2 (REINFORCE replays every minibatch sample at one shared end-of-episode rule_state -- faithful to 822f and reproduced deliberately) ACCEPTED as a real interpretive limit and recorded in the manifest as interpretation.unexcluded_rivals with per-update rule_state_norm telemetry for a successor. PRE-REGISTRATION VERIFICATION: every grid branch reachable, measured at real warmup before queuing (ARM_ON seed 611, p0=60/p1=20): 629 rule-live ticks, flip fraction 0.1049, both sample classes populated, return variance 0.374, median gradient norm 0.0091. Smoke PASS; validate_experiments --strict clean (1 OK, 0 warnings).
